en.headline: Man assaulted in failed robbery bid at Tuen Mun Yau Oi Estate
en.dek: A 33-year-old man was injured but lost no property after two men in white tops attacked him outside Oi Tak House early Saturday.
body: Police were called to Yau Oi Estate in Tuen Mun at about 4:19am on Saturday after a 33-year-old local man surnamed Leung reported being attacked while walking near Oi Tak House.

According to police, two men wearing white tops suddenly approached and assaulted him in an attempt to take his belongings. He resisted and shouted for help. The suspects fled when they failed to seize any property.
The victim sustained abrasions to his mouth and hands. He was taken to Tuen Mun Hospital for treatment and remained conscious. He suffered no property loss.

Officers have classified the case as assault with intent to rob. No one has been arrested. Police are reviewing CCTV footage in the area to identify the two men, described as aged between 20 and 40 and about 1.7 metres tall.

zh.headline: 屯門友愛邨男夜歸遭兩男襲擊企圖行劫不果
zh.dek: 33歲事主口部及手部擦傷，財物無失，兩名身穿白色上衣男子逃去。
body: 警方今日凌晨約4時19分接報，一名33歲姓梁本地男子在屯門友愛邨愛德樓對開步行時，遭兩名男子襲擊。
警方表示，兩名身穿白色上衣的男子突然撲向事主並毆打他，企圖搶走其財物。事主力拒並高聲呼救，兩人未能得手後逃離現場。
事主口部及手部擦傷，清醒送往屯門醫院治理，並無財物損失。
案件列作意圖搶劫而襲擊處理，暫時未有人被捕。警方正翻查附近閉路電視，追緝兩名約20至40歲、身高約1.7米的男子。
